description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayDiscoveryModel component, validating its methods such as isLocalGateway, parseGatewayTXT, buildSSHTarget, and dedupeKey, as well as testing various gateway discovery scenarios.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: A model class handling gateway discovery logic, including parsing TXT records, matching local gateways, and deduplication of gateway sources.

methods.name: isLocalGateway
methods.description: Determines if a given gateway matches the local gateway based on host, DNS, display name, or service name criteria.

methods.name: parseGatewayTXT
methods.description: Parses TXT record key-value pairs received from gateway discovery protocols into structured data.

methods.name: buildSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH target string from user, host, and port information.

methods.name: shouldContinueTailscaleServeDiscovery
methods.description: Decides whether to continue or stop the Tailscale serve discovery process based on current and known gateways.

methods.name: dedupeKey
methods.description: Generates a deduplication key for a discovered gateway, prioritizing resolved endpoints and falling back to a stable ID.
